verdict.line: You lose if you let him hit free Qs and poke you down before level 6; you win if you force all-ins where Skaarl's extra body absorbs his burst.

brief.thesis: Ornn's entire kit is zone control through Volcanic Rupture (Q) and the Brittle tag from Bellows Breath (W) or Searing Charge (E), but none of it stops Kled's dismounted sustain-through-damage passive. Kled vs Ornn sits at 47.1% over 70 games despite Kled holding the lane-advantage and solo-kill-advantage tags, which means the matchup is close until you understand that trading stance matters more than raw cooldowns here.

theirWindow.when: Q (Volcanic Rupture) and E (Searing Charge) both up
theirWindow.what: OP.GG flags this exact combo — the Q fissure slows you into the E charge's knockup zone. If he has both up and is walking toward you with intent, back off and let a minion eat the fissure instead of trading face to face.

yourWindow.when: his Q (Volcanic Rupture) just missed or is on cooldown (7-9s)
yourWindow.what: Jousting in with E immediately — he has no slow to stop your dash and no knockup threat until Searing Charge resets. Land W (Violent Tendencies) autos during this window since he can't punish the attack-speed steroid with anything but basic autos.

boots.why: 52.5% win rate and the higher pick (59.7%) over Plated Steelcaps; the tenacity matters more here because Ornn's W Brittle setups chain into ganks and R (Call of the Forge God) knockups, and you need to shake those faster than you need pure damage reduction.

runes.keystoneWhy: the 47.8%-pick page built around Conqueror matches how this lane actually plays — Ornn wants short poke trades, and Conqueror rewards you for staying in extended fights where his Q/E combo whiffs after the first hit

playing.title: Bait the Q before committing
playing.detail: Volcanic Rupture is on a 7-9s cooldown depending on rank; if you see him throw it and miss, that's your green light to Joust in without eating the slow.

playing.title: Never engage with both Q and E up
playing.detail: OP.GG's own warning is correct — the Rupture-to-Searing-Charge combo is a slow into a knockup, and it's the single biggest damage spike in his kit. Walk around it, don't trade into it.

playing.title: Dismount fights are still your fights
playing.detail: Once Skaarl drops, your Q becomes Pocket Pistol — use the knockback to reset distance from his E charge, then rebuild courage by landing W autos on him, not minions.

playing.title: Save R for his flash or your kill window
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! has a 3500 range but a 110-140s cooldown — don't burn it to start a fight he can just E away from; use it to punish overextensions after he's thrown Q.

playing.title: Track his gold for Living Forge spikes
playing.detail: His passive lets him forge items anywhere, which can mean a surprise armor or MR item mid-fight — don't assume his resistances are fixed just because you haven't seen a base trip.

playing.title: Push waves when his Q is down
playing.detail: Without Volcanic Rupture up, he has no safe way to contest a fast-pushed wave; use these windows to shove and set up your own jungler's gank angle.

playing.title: Itemize Cleaver before his third resistance item
playing.detail: His passive bonus armor/MR from every item stacks fast — rushing Black Cleaver's shred keeps your Titanic Hydra autos relevant into mid-game.

brief.patchCaveat: The build order, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers above are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tactical reasoning connecting them to specific cooldowns and trade windows is my own read of the matchup.
